purpose: AI-generated illustrative category visuals based on the original Tekbatt website images; not manufacturer photography.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / product-mockup.
Asset type: premium B2B battery website product-category image.
Edit the supplied official product image into a new, exceptionally sharp professional studio photograph. The reference is authoritative for product identity and wrapper design. Keep AgfaPhoto branding and the product family's colours recognisable. Do not rebrand the batteries as Tekbatt.
Composition: landscape 4:3, high resolution, four AA cells arranged as a compact elegant product group, three upright at slightly varied depths and one lying horizontally in the foreground, all fully visible. Entire product group centered within the central 70% of image width and central 70% of image height with generous safe margins. Natural photographic proportions, physically plausible cylindrical batteries, flawless metallic positive terminals, precise edges, small real contact shadows. Premium commercial still-life photography, 85mm lens, f/11, deep focus so every product is tack sharp.
Background: a seamless warm off-white studio surface #f3f2ee, same tone behind and under the cells, subtle tonal depth only. Soft large window light from upper left and controlled silver highlights. Refined neutral colour grading, no vignette, no hard spotlight, no saturated background.
Remove retail blister packs, back-of-pack artwork, QR codes, loose papers, price claims and all decorative objects. Do not add advertising text, capacity numbers, warranty claims or slogans. Only retain the actual short brand / family labels on the cylindrical product wrappers. No extra logos outside the products, no floating cells, no water, no leaves, no plinth, no split panels, no collage.
The result is one clean illustration of the real battery family for a website category card.
Subject: black AgfaPhoto Alkaline Ultra AA cells, black cylindrical wraps with silver ends, red circular mark and vertical white/grey AGFAPHOTO lettering, matching the loose cells in the reference. Preserve the black/silver/red identity. Text on visible wrappers: AGFAPHOTO, ALKALINE ULTRA; no other claims.
